adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Movements outward from the hip; angularity with the body bent at the waist.
movement_profile.posture: Downward, earth-bound orientation with flexed or soft knees.
movement_profile.tempo_feel: Influenced by the spirit of the dancers.

music_profile.sound_description: The music is centered on the melody of the mbira, which is plucked with the fingers, supported by the polyrhythmic textures of drums and shakers.

basic_steps: Maintain a downward, earth-bound posture with flexed knees.
Incorporate hip-led movements and angular body shapes.
teaching.formation: Communal; participants sing, play, or dance together with few to no spectators.
teaching.rhythm: Polyrhythmic; the performer may pace movements to create new rhythms.
